name: zee-css
description: A TypeScript-based CSS utility library with comprehensive theming, responsive variants, and state variants

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/core && npm run build --workspace=packages/cli
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspace=packages/core && npm run clean --workspace=packages/cli
scripts.publish:all: npm run build && npm run publish:core && npm run publish:cli
scripts.pack:dry: cd packages/core && npm pack --dry-run && cd ../cli && npm pack --dry-run

author: praballl
